gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-batak: College lays fine rope into its letters, each curve matching the stems, while Noto Sans Batak sits underneath with a towering x-height. Its wide e keeps long paragraphs open and never pinched.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-devanaga: Noto Sans Devanagari reads quick and compact, its g open at the bottom and capitals melting into the lowercase. College belongs up large and brief, where its uniform stroke can show off.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Noto Sans Duployan opens its lowercase a with a wide mouth. College leads in uninterrupted line width on every letter, and the two make a loud-then-quiet rhythm down the page.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: College bends every letter like tubing of one gauge, dynamic and authoritative with tall, generous counters. But Noto Sans Elymaic does the quieter work, with open apertures and ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-georgian: College looks bent from a single wire, every curve matching its stems, with generous counters in tall letters. Give College the large sizes and let Noto Sans Georgian handle the text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads clean, its brush ends lifting away before each curve closes. And College, cut like sign-shop vinyl at a single line width, gives the opening line a firm voice.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: College looks like tubular wire bent into letters, dynamic and authoritative, while Noto Sans Lepcha stands tall with wide curves. Over a full column it feels approachable and steady.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-limbu: College is a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness, while Noto Sans Limbu has gaping curves and tall small letters. Down a full page, that body feels open and welcoming.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lydian: College draws a steel cable outline with no swing between heavy and light strokes, dynamic and firm. And Noto Sans Lydian brings an opening as wide as a sprung paper clip, the sharpest difference here.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Straight-backed and sturdy, College keeps its bowls free of any swelling, dynamic and authoritative from the first word. But Noto Sans Mahajani does the patient work, its lowercase standing tall with a funnel-wide throat in the e.
